items.exampleEn: Rain is abundant here in spring.
She has traveled extensively in Asia.
items.exampleZh: 她在亞洲各地廣泛旅行過。

items.exampleEn: A short walk can lessen the stress of a long day.
items.exampleZh: 散個步可以減輕漫長一天的壓力。

items.exampleEn: Our cat gets a small ration of food twice a day.
items.exampleZh: 我們的貓一天吃兩次定量的食物。

items.exampleEn: The beach is about two miles from here.
items.exampleZh: 海灘離這裡大約兩英里。

items.exampleEn: About sixty percent of the staff walk to work.
items.exampleZh: 大約百分之六十的員工走路上班。

items.sentenceEn: The temperature tonight will be minus five degrees.
items.sentenceZh: 今晚的氣溫會是零下五度。

items.audioEn: The hotel is three miles from the airport, so a taxi takes about ten minutes.
items.audioZh: 飯店離機場三英里，所以搭計程車大約十分鐘。

items.sentenceEn: Prices rose by five percent last year.
items.sentenceZh: 去年物價上漲了百分之五。

items.sentenceEn: The new road will lessen traffic in the city center.
items.sentenceZh: 新道路將減輕市中心的交通量。

items.stemEn: This book has been ____ used in schools around the world.
items.stemZh: 這本書被世界各地的學校廣泛使用。

items.stemEn: During the trip, each person got a daily ____ of rice and water.
items.stemZh: 旅途中，每人每天分到定量的米和水。

items.passageEn: Our town is famous for its abundant hot springs. Visitors come from miles away to relax in the warm water. A recent study found that eighty percent of visitors feel less stress after a visit, and many say they sleep better. The town's hot springs have also been studied extensively by scientists. In winter, the temperature outside can drop to minus two degrees, but the water stays at about forty degrees.
items.passageZh: 我們小鎮以豐富的溫泉聞名。遊客從好幾英里外來這裡，在溫暖的泉水中放鬆。最近一項研究發現，百分之八十的遊客泡完溫泉後覺得壓力變小，很多人也說睡得比較好。科學家也對這裡的溫泉做過廣泛的研究。冬天時，外面的氣溫可能降到零下二度，但泉水仍維持在大約四十度。

questions.questionZh: 有多少比例的遊客說，泡完溫泉後覺得壓力變小？
冬天時，外面的氣溫可能低到幾度？

items.promptZh: 這家店所有東西都打八折。
referenceEn: Everything in this shop is twenty percent off.
All the items in this store are twenty percent off.
rubricZh: percent 前面接數字（例如 twenty percent）
「打八折」是減價百分之二十，可寫，例如 twenty percent off、20% off 等
寫 There is a twenty percent discount on everything. 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 mile 造一個句子，說說某個地方離你家多遠，或你走、跑了多遠。
referenceEn: My office is about five miles from my home.
I ran three miles in the park this morning.
rubricZh: mile 表示「英里」，數字大於一要用複數 miles
可用 from 說明距離的起點（例如 five miles from my home）
說的是自己的生活（例如 I、my）
